data.name: Inayati
data.gender_notes: Inayati is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Favour, blessing, or divine pleasure. The name Inayati carries the meaning “Favour” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Inayati usually hope their child will grow to embody favour and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Inayati belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Favour.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Inayati total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عِنايَتي
in_arabic.meaning: العناية الالهية، الحفظ الرباني، الرعاية الإلهية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عِنايَتي مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ن-ي' والذي يعني العناية والحفظ. يدل على معنى الرعاية الإلهية والحماية الربانية. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع بمعنى العناية والحفظ. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على الثقة بالله ورعايته.

in_urdu.name: عِنایتی
in_urdu.meaning: الہی نگہداشت، ربانی حفاظت، الہی مراقبت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عِنایتی نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ن-ي' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نگہداشت اور حفاظت۔ یہ الہی نگہداشت اور ربانی حفاظت کے معنی میں اسلامی ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں اس جڑ کا ذکر کئی جگہوں پر نگہداشت اور حفاظت کے معنی میں ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इनायती
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वरीय देखभाल, ईश्वरीय सुरक्षा, परमात्मा की निगरानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: इनायती नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ع-ن-ي' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है देखभाल और सुरक्षा। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में ईश्वरीय देखभाल और सुरक्षा के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। अरबी भाषा में इस जड़ का उल्लेख कई स्थानों पर देखभाल और सुरक्षा के अर्थ में मिलता है।

in_pashto.name: عینایتي
in_pashto.meaning: الهي پاملنه، رباني حفاظت، الهي نظارت
in_pashto.long_meaning: عینایتي نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع-ن-ي' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې پاملنه او حفاظت ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې د الهي پاملنې او رباني حفاظت په معنی استعمال شوی دی. په قرآن کریم کې د دې جڑ یادونه په ډیری ځایونو کې د پاملنې او حفاظت په معنی شوې ده.

in_english.name: Inayati
in_english.meaning: Divine care, Lordly protection, heavenly guardianship
in_english.long_meaning: The name Inayati is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-ن-ي' which signifies care, protection, and guardianship. It symbolizes trust in God's providence and care. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects the belief in divine protection and Lordly guardianship. The root appears in several Quranic verses emphasizing care and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Inayati" has its roots in the Arabic language, which is the primary language of the Islamic faith. The name is derived from the Arabic word "inayah," meaning "favour," "blessing," or "divine pleasure." In many Muslim communities, names hold profound significance and are often chosen based on various meanings and traits. A name like "Inayati" would be highly regarded, as it signifies the recipient receiving God's grace, blessings, and favour.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, carrying the name "Inayati" could be seen as a reminder of the importance of seeking and receiving God's blessings and favours. It encourages the individual to establish a deep spiritual connection with God, as they understand that everything they have or achieve comes from His divine mercy and generosity. In turn, this can lead to a life filled with gratitude, humility, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Favour" symbolizes Favour, blessing, or divine pleasure.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Inayati serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of favour.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Inayati is mentioned in the 13th century Sufi text "The Conference of Birds" The name Inayati carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Inayati is mentioned as a mystical name in the context of Sufi poetry

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Inayati remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
